narration: In month {fork_month}, with a cracked screen and a battery dying by afternoon, you chose {real_choice} and the ghost took {ghost_choice}. In month {first_bar_apart_month}, Safety was the first score to part, the two cushions no longer the same size. The ghost's net worth sat above yours for {ghost_ahead_months} months, then in month {crossover_month} it slipped below and never came back. When the layoff came in month {layoff_month}, the ghost had {layoff_net_worth_gap}. By month {end_month}, the widest point of the whole run, the ghost finished with {net_worth_gap}.
